label: team_0140_cassiopeia_00
text: It’s finally over, guys... It’s done.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_01
text: We’re done here. I think we should call it quits.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0140_akuboss_01
text: Hold up—are you sayin’ we should break up\nthe team...?\c\nYou gotta be joking![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_02
text: We got carried away with Operation Star...\nNow everything’s gotten out of hand.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0140_honooboss_01
text: Yeah, well, that’s what happens when you round\nup a buncha bullies in the courtyard and make a\r\nshow of learning ’em some manners.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: team_0140_kakutouboss_01
text: But we didn’t even fight them in the end.\nWe didn’t do anything wrong![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: team_0140_dokuboss_01
text:
Indeed. Merely did we declare our intention to
battle tooth and nail should the villains persist
in their tyrannous oppression.\c
’Twas a bloodless victory, we assure you![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: team_0140_fairyboss_01
text: Yeah! They didn’t even send out their Pokémon—\nthey just blubbered and apologized a whole lot...\r\nOur outfits must’ve spooked them good![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_03
text:
But the bullies made a huge stink about what
went down, and then they all ended up leaving
the academy.\c
Our plan backfired epically. There’s no way we’re
getting off scot-free.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0140_akuboss_02
text: I guess you’re right... This little stunt might’ve put\nus up the creek.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_04
text: I’ll fix this mess on my end. Just leave it to me.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0140_honooboss_02
text: What’re you saying?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_05
text: I’m the one who started Team Star. I dragged you\nall into this.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_06
text: So I’ll take responsibility for everything.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0140_dokuboss_02
text: Oh, noble and kind big boss. You cannot...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_07
text: Now that the bullies are gone, you guys should\nstart going to school again.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0140_honooboss_03
text: Oh yeah? And what about you?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_08
text: I can’t go back...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0140_akuboss_03
text: Why? There’s no reason for you to stay shut in\nyour room anymore, right?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_09
text: All I can say to you guys is...thanks.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_10
text: Even though we never met in person, you were\nall so kind to me...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0140_kakutouboss_02
text: Stop right there, B.B.! Why are you talking like\nwe’ll never speak again?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_11
text: I need to go take care of some things...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0140_dokuboss_03
text: Prithee, speak to us! What is thine intent?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

label: team_0140_fairyboss_02
text: Hey, Big Boss! Answer us![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

label: team_0140_cassiopeia_13
text: Bye-bye, guys... Thanks for everything.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
